methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.
Seek an exact dirty-input or chronological-cut counterexample to the proposed replacement.

Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

original_card.first_experiment: Write one replacement H2/K implication for a single helper-star operation, then try to falsify it on dirty inputs.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A legitimate replacement could admit a cheaper bit circuit; scalar savings alone do not alter the selected moment.
allowed_variations: Choose one helper-star or quartet instance; narrow to one boundary implication.
scope_change_triggers: Changing only source count or scalar addition count without an interface argument.

actual_scope: On one canonical root, exchanging all address halves and then the normal line equals exchanging the complement, and the two frames send that root to opposite banks.
scope_change_reason: The stage bills, the six-step closure and the forward-mass screen are different questions. This package checks this operator identity. It does not rerun the port boundary charts.
bottleneck_link: The full frame and its complement move the same root to opposite banks, and the selected kappa is unchanged.
stop_rule: Record this identity. Do not rerun the port boundary charts.
evidence: The composition agrees on all 16 basis pairs. The full exchange sends the root to the tail bank and the complement leaves it on the head bank.
